# cert/map: full certification list

> 478 cybersecurity certifications from 93 vendors, grouped by domain and ordered from beginner to expert. Prices are exam list prices in USD. Generated from data/certs.csv; last price check 2026-11-10.

Source: https://certmap.dev/
Dataset: https://certmap.dev/data/certs.csv and https://certmap.dev/data/certs.json
Licence: CC BY 4.0 (dataset), MIT (code)

## Communication & Network Security

### CNSP: Certified Network Security Practitioner

Entry-level proctored multiple-choice exam on network security fundamentals, with factual and scenario-based questions. The certificate does not expire.

- Vendor: The SecOps Group
- Level: beginner
- Exam price: $134 (Vendor lists GBP only (GBP 100); converted at 1.3423 USD/GBP (ECB reference rate, 2026-11-10); frequent promotional discounts)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 60 minutes
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://pentestingexams.com/certifications/essentials/certified-network-security-practitioner/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/cnsp.html

### CWNA: Certified Wireless Network Administrator

Vendor-neutral enterprise Wi-Fi administration certification with a 60-question exam. It is the required base credential for the CWNP professional-level certifications.

- Vendor: CWNP
- Level: beginner
- Exam price: $275 (List price $274.99 (exam CWNA-110))
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 90 minutes
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: every 3 years
- Official page: https://www.cwnp.com/certifications/cwna
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/cwna.html

- Vendor: Juniper

### ZTCA: Zscaler Zero Trust Cyber Associate

Entry-level certification on zero trust principles and architecture. Earned by completing a 5-hour self-paced course and a 120-minute exam of 75 questions, with up to three retests.

- Vendor: Zscaler
- Level: beginner
- Exam price: Not published (Exam fee not shown on the certification page; preceded by a 5-hour self-paced e-learning course)
- Exam length: 120 minutes
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://www.zscaler.com/zscaler-academy/ztca-zero-trust-certified-associate
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/ztca.html

### CU NetSec: University of Colorado Fundamentals of Computer Network Security Specialization

Four-course University of Colorado System specialization covering secure system design, applied cryptography and PKI, penetration testing basics, and firewalls and intrusion detection. Course-based certificate assessed through projects on cloud instances, with no proctored exam.

- Vendor: Coursera
- Issued by: University of Colorado
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: Not published (Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 4 weeks at 10 hours a week (the page FAQ says about 16 weeks).)
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://www.coursera.org/specializations/computer-network-security
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/coursera-colorado-network-security.html

### GAWN: GIAC Assessing and Auditing Wireless Networks

Covers attacks on weak wireless encryption, 802.11 fuzzing, Bluetooth, RFID and NFC, rogue networks, software-defined radio, hotspots and WPA. One proctored exam of 75 questions in two hours, passing score 70%.

- Vendor: GIAC
- Level: advanced
- Exam price: $999 (Exam only)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 120 minutes
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: every 4 years
- Official page: https://www.giac.org/certifications/assessing-auditing-wireless-networks-gawn/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/gawn.html

### GCIA: GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst

Covers traffic analysis and application protocols, the open-source IDS tools Snort and Zeek, and network traffic forensics and monitoring. One proctored exam of 106 questions in four hours with CyberLive tasks, passing score 67%.

- Vendor: GIAC
- Level: advanced
- Exam price: $999 (Exam only)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 240 minutes
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: every 4 years
- DoD 8140: approved
- Official page: https://www.giac.org/certifications/certified-intrusion-analyst-gcia/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/gcia.html

### CWNE: Certified Wireless Network Expert

Top CWNP credential awarded by board review, not by exam. Applicants must hold the CWNP professional certifications plus CWISA and one external networking certification, and submit essays, publications and three endorsements; renewal requires 60 continuing education credits.

- Vendor: CWNP
- Level: expert
- Exam price: $500 (Application fee; there is no CWNE exam, the prerequisite certification exams are paid separately)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: does not expire
- Prerequisites: CWNA, CWSP
- Official page: https://www.cwnp.com/certifications/cwne/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/cwne.html

### CWPE: HTB Certified Wi-Fi Pentesting Expert

Practical exam on attacking WEP, WPS, WPA2, WPA3 and WPA-Enterprise networks, rogue access points and pivoting into internal networks, with a written report. Requires completing the Wi-Fi Penetration Tester job-role path.

- Vendor: Hack The Box
- Level: expert
- Exam price: $350 (Exam voucher only, two attempts; job-role path access sold separately)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 7 days
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://academy.hackthebox.com/preview/certifications/htb-certified-wi-fi-pentesting-expert
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/cwpe.html

### GX-IA: GIAC Experienced Intrusion Analyst

Applied Knowledge exam of 25 CyberLive hands-on challenges in four hours, open book, covering protocol analysis of packet captures, network forensics and intrusion analysis with tools such as Wireshark, Scapy and IDS tooling. Counts toward the GSE portfolio.

- Vendor: GIAC
- Level: expert
- Exam price: $1,299 (Applied Knowledge exam; $499 for holders of the corresponding active base Practitioner certification (GCIA is the audience named on the page))
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 240 minutes
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: every 4 years
- Official page: https://www.giac.org/certifications/experienced-intrusion-analyst-gxia/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/gx-ia.html

### NSE 8: Fortinet NSE 8 Cybersecurity Expert

Top Fortinet certification, formerly FCX. Requires NSE 4, an NSE 5 or NSE 6 and an NSE 7 in the same track, then the NSE 8 Core Practical Exam (on-site only) and one elective practical exam passed within a year.

- Vendor: Fortinet
- Level: expert
- Exam price: Not published (Fortinet publishes exam prices only to signed-in users)
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: every 2 years
- Prerequisites: NSE 4, NSE 5
- Official page: https://training.fortinet.com/local/staticpage/view.php?page=nse_8
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/nse8.html

## OSINT

### Basel OSINT: Basel LEARN Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT)

Free self-paced OSINT course for financial and corruption investigators built around a simulated illegal fishing case that ends with an OSINT report. It awards a certificate of completion from the International Centre for Asset Recovery rather than an examined certification, and is widely used in the asset recovery and OSINT community.

- Vendor: Basel Institute
- Level: beginner
- Exam price: Free (Free self-paced eLearning course)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: does not expire

## Forensics

### DAF: Chainalysis Digital Asset Fundamentals

Core blockchain concepts, digital asset mechanics and the UTXO and account-based models. Required before every other Chainalysis certification.

- Vendor: Chainalysis
- Level: beginner
- Exam price: Not published (Foundational modules are open to anyone without a licence; the full pathway is included with a Chainalysis licence)
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://www.chainalysis.com/digital-asset-fundamentals/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/chainalysis-daf.html

### TRM-CFC: TRM Cryptocurrency Fundamentals

Foundational TRM Labs course covering blockchain analysis and cryptocurrency tracing basics.

- Vendor: TRM Labs
- Level: beginner
- Exam price: $1,000
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://www.trmlabs.com/training-and-certifications/crypto-fundamentals
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/trm-cfc.html

### CCE: Certified Computer Examiner

Digital forensics certification offered by ISFCE since 2003. Applicants need approved training and 18 months of verifiable professional experience for the full designation.

- Vendor: ISFCE
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: $495 (CCE Examination Test fee; recertification every two years costs $250)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: every 2 years
- Official page: https://isfce.com/cce-certification.html
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/isfce-cce.html

### CCI: Chainalysis Certified Investigator

Investigator-track credential from Chainalysis Academy on tracing cryptocurrency transactions with Chainalysis tools. Chainalysis Digital Asset Fundamentals is a required prerequisite.

- Vendor: Chainalysis
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: Not published (No per-seat fee; certifications are included with a Chainalysis licence)
- Exam format: written or multiple choice
- Renewal: does not expire
- Prerequisites: DAF
- Restricted to: Chainalysis licence holders
- Official page: https://www.chainalysis.com/certified-investigator/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/chainalysis-cci.html

### CCO: Cellebrite Certified Operator for Inseyets

Mobile device unlocking, extraction, decoding and data review with Cellebrite Inseyets. Earned by passing a knowledge test and a practical skills assessment (80% minimum) at the end of the 2-day course; renewed every two years through a recertification exam.

- Vendor: Cellebrite
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: Not published (Price on request (no public price; registration via Cellebrite Community portal); exam included with the 2-day course, usually taken as a 5-day CCO + CCPA bundle)
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: every 2 years
- Official page: https://cellebrite.com/training/cellebrite-training-inseyets/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/ccfp.html

- Renewal: every 2 years

### ILD: Investigating Linux Devices

Linux forensics covering log analysis, file systems, persistence mechanisms, memory forensics, live response, evidence collection and timelining. Certification is earned by passing the course Knowledge Assessment, which has a multiple-choice part and a hands-on practical part; it does not expire.

- Vendor: 13Cubed
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: $895 (Course price with 365-day access; one certification attempt (Knowledge Assessment) is included and is not sold separately)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://training.13cubed.com/investigating-linux-devices
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/13cubed-ild.html

### IME: Investigating macOS Endpoints

macOS forensics covering the Unified Logging System, HFS+ and APFS, core forensic artifacts, persistence mechanisms, evidence collection and timelining. Certification is earned by passing the course Knowledge Assessment, which has a multiple-choice part and a hands-on practical part; it does not expire.

- Vendor: 13Cubed
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: $895 (Course price with 365-day access; one certification attempt (Knowledge Assessment) is included and is not sold separately)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10

- Official page: https://training.13cubed.com/investigating-macos-endpoints
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/13cubed-ime.html

### IWE: Investigating Windows Endpoints

Windows host forensics covering event logs, the registry, evidence of execution, persistence and lateral movement, NTFS, file recovery and timelining. Certification is earned by passing the course Knowledge Assessment, which has a multiple-choice part and a hands-on practical part; it does not expire.

- Vendor: 13Cubed
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: $795 (Course price with 365-day access; one certification attempt (Knowledge Assessment) is included and is not sold separately)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10

### IWM: Investigating Windows Memory

### CAWFE: Certified Advanced Windows Forensic Examiner

Advanced Windows forensics certification with an open-book written test of 125 questions (up to eight hours, 80% to pass) and a practical exam on image files and Windows artifacts completed within 30 days. Recertification requires a proficiency exercise in the third year and 40 hours of continuing education.

- Vendor: IACIS
- Level: advanced
- Exam price: $800 (External certification fee (certification only, training not included); external candidates must show 36 hours of relevant training; fee is waived for students of the matching IACIS course; 2026 registration closes December 15)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: every 3 years
- Official page: https://www.iacis.com/certification/cawfe/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/cawfe.html

### CFCE: Certified Forensic Computer Examiner

Two-phase digital forensics certification: a peer review of four practical problems, then a hard drive practical and a 100-question knowledge test. External candidates must show 72 hours of relevant training.

- Vendor: IACIS
- Level: advanced
- Exam price: $800 (External certification fee; candidates who attend the IACIS BCFE course are entered automatically)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: every 3 years
- Official page: https://www.iacis.com/certification/cfce/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/cfce.html

Candidates must score 80% or above on both a time-limited practical skills assessment of two device examinations and a proctored 75-question knowledge exam, within 45 days of enrollment.

- Vendor: Cellebrite
- Level: expert
- Exam price: Not published (Price on request (page says to log in to MyCellebrite for all costs); requires prior CCO, CCPA and the CASA course)
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: every 2 years

- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/ccme.html

- Exam length: 240 minutes
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: every 4 years
- Official page: https://www.giac.org/certifications/experienced-penetration-tester-gxpt
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/gx-pt.html

### LPT: Licensed Penetration Tester Master

Elite penetration testing credential awarded for scoring 90 percent or higher on EC-Council's 24-hour online proctored CPENT live-range exam.

- Vendor: EC-Council
- Level: expert
- Exam price: $999 (CPENT Exam + Range (store price); LPT (Master) is awarded for scoring 90% or higher on the CPENT exam, there is no separate LPT exam)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 24 hours
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: every 3 years
- Prerequisites: CEH
- Official page: https://www.eccouncil.org/train-certify/licensed-penetration-tester-lpt-master/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/lpt.html

## Exploitation

### CBFRPro: Certified Binary Fuzzing & Reversing Professional

Four-hour practical exam on binary fuzzing and reverse engineering, covering memory corruption bugs, disassembly and debugging, taken online and on demand over a VPN. The certificate does not expire.

- Vendor: The SecOps Group
- Level: intermediate
- Exam price: $336 (Vendor lists GBP only (GBP 250); converted at 1.3423 USD/GBP (ECB reference rate, 2026-11-10); frequent promotional discounts; one free retake included)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 240 minutes
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://pentestingexams.com/certifications/professional/certified-binary-fuzzing-reversing-professional/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/cbfrpro.html

### CASR: Certified Android Security Researcher

24-hour practical exam on Android internals, including app sandboxing, SELinux, AOSP debugging and security mitigations, assessed through a report with working proof-of-concept scripts.

- Vendor: 8kSec
- Level: advanced
- Exam price: Not published (Offered on completion of the accompanying 8kSec training class; no standalone exam price published)
- Exam length: 24 hours
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://8ksec.io/casr/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/casr.html

### CEDP: Certified Exploit Development Professional

Exploit development certification covering stack-based vulnerabilities, memory corruption and debugging. Assessed by a task-based exam with no fixed end date, submitted as a PDF report.

- Vendor: CyberWarFare Labs
- Level: advanced
- Exam price: $29 (Includes course material and two exam attempts; lower promotional prices are frequent)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://cyberwarfare.live/certifications/exploit-development-professional-cedp
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/cedp.html

### CISR: Certified iOS Security Researcher

24-hour practical exam on iOS internals, including sandboxing, Mach and XPC IPC, memory management and code signing, assessed through a report with working proofs of concept.

- Vendor: 8kSec
- Level: advanced
- Exam price: Not published (Offered on completion of the accompanying 8kSec training class; no standalone exam price published)
- Exam length: 24 hours
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://8ksec.io/cisr/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/cisr.html

### CWI-RTO: Certified Windows Internals Red Team Operator

Certification on Windows internals for offensive work, covering Win32 and NT APIs, kernel data structures and debugging with WinDbg. Assessed by a task-based exam with no fixed end date, submitted as a PDF report.

- Vendor: CyberWarFare Labs
- Level: advanced
- Exam price: $29 (Includes course material and the exam; lower promotional prices are frequent)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: does not expire

- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/cwi-rto.html

### ODPC: Offensive Development Practitioner Certification

Covers development of custom offensive tooling such as shellcode loaders, reflective payloads and process injection, with AMSI and ETW bypass, API unhooking and EDR evasion. Assessed by a 48-hour practical exam in a student-deployed AWS lab followed by 48 hours to submit a report.

- Vendor: White Knight Labs
- Level: advanced
- Exam price: $700 (Course with lifetime access and one exam voucher that does not expire; page shows 'starting at' USD 700)
- Price checked: 2026-11-10
- Exam length: 2 days
- Exam format: hands-on, performance-based
- Renewal: does not expire
- Official page: https://training.whiteknightlabs.com/certifications/offensive-development-practitioner-certification/
- cert/map page: https://certmap.dev/certs/odpc.html
